source_pin_provenance: evaluation/change-cost-v2/pins.json; existing fastapi/axum pins reused, not inferred from scores
keyed_development_sample_recipe: Use the last 2000 first-parent commits through the exact pinned inclusive tip. Exclusive C0_dev is the 2000th first-parent ancestor; if the chain is shorter, C0_dev is the root and the window is full ancestry minus the root. Resolve and seal exact boundary SHAs only after authorised object fetch; no moving refs or window extension.

At each window commit and first parent collect model-free introduced/regressed issues with identical pinned scanner/rule/tool/effective-policy bytes and heuristic mapping. Apply only first-occurrence, repeated, pre-existing-at-C0_dev and unknown-attribution exclusions. Test freshness/exposure exclusions and test run-size eligibility do not apply. Examined units stay eligible, flagged and counted, and require current-guide labels; legacy labels never count. Dev quantities are per unit.

Order all eligible units by ascending HMAC-SHA256 digest, UTF-8 key 169-x1-dev, message repository NUL full commit SHA NUL issue ID; full SHA then UTF-8 issue ID break digest collisions. Repository is exact UTF-8 case-preserved owner/name above; SHA/run ID is full 40-character lowercase hexadecimal; issue ID is exact UTF-8 Scout issue ID. Greedily skip a unit once its commit has five selected units. Select 150 per repository with at most 5 units per commit, therefore at least 30 distinct commits per repository. Report distinct commits, selected identities and dev source-commit size distribution against the test frame. Unweighted estimates describe the commit-balanced mixture; unequal per-commit inclusion and the 2023-versus-2024+ era gap limit transport.

If either repository cannot supply 150 units under these rules, stop insufficient before dev models. No replacement repository, smaller target, window extension or legacy-label substitution. n_max remains 300.

Collection belongs to inventory, after preparation seals and authentic passing model-free binding checks. Include both development windows' commit/parent scans in inventory elapsed/resource projection. After separately authorised current-guide labelling, dev gates require at least 200 completed cases; none executed here.
missing_prerequisites: Exact pinned repository objects/local clone paths are not available at the documented historical paths; an authorised object source is required.
Zero-issue review must approve this keyed development sample recipe and the exact resolved boundaries before collection.
Authentic model-free effective-policy binding checks, sealed preparation outputs and inventory review are required; the isolated GUIDE session belongs to stage 3.
